annotations.title: Check a business number before calling

description: Call this BEFORE placing a phone call to a business. It often saves the call entirely: in a test of 125 real business websites, about a third could be handled through an online booking link instead of a call. Returns whether the business can be booked or reached online instead (with the link), whether it has asked not to receive AI calls, whether this caller has been opted out, and pooled call data from other callers (answer rate, hold time, phone-menu path, best hours). advice is one of: use_link, do_not_call, call, unknown.

country.description: ISO country code, only needed for national-format numbers (US, CA, AU, NZ, GB, IE)

website.description: The business's website, if known. Enables the online-booking check.

name: check_before_call

pooled.description: What other callers found: answer rate, hold time, phone-menu path, best hours
